answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using flow-based trust networks that bound transaction flow via mutual peer attestations. These edges anchor reputation like solid marble, arresting any runaway spiral of fraudulent identities across network bottlenecks. An attacker incurs a scarce cost in authentic trust links, forced to crack honest clusters like a walnut to route synthetic traffic. However, this structure inherently marginalizes nascent, honest agents that lack connectivity.
